entities.summary: Albert Likeke Mongita, also known as Mongita Likeke (1916–1985) was an actor, dramatist, painter, filmmaker and theatre director from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Mongita was "one of the leaders of the national theatre movement in the decades after World War II".
